name: Brennstoffemissionshandel (nEHS) certificate price
law: BEHG § 10 (2): 2026 certificates are auctioned in a corridor of 55 to 65 euro. This is the volume-weighted clearing price of the 11 auctions EEX held (01.07.2026 to 09.09.2026; clearing prices 65 euro). Certificates bought after the auctions cost 68 euro (the excess quantity price), so a supplier's average may be a little higher.
